name: NoVAAdminTaxReturnEvening

custom.system_prompt: Becky and Yusuf work through a tax return. A deadline question comes up and resolves without Sigma — the form itself, an old reminder email, or deciding to file early.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Kitchen table evening, laptop keys, paper shuffled, a mug set down, a printer refusing to work, quiet street.

initial_prompt: Generate a natural conversation between Becky and Yusuf at their kitchen table working through a tax return with freelance income neither fully understands. They talk about the travel year, Becky's course, a wedding task they are avoiding, whether to pay an accountant. Becky says the deadline is end of January; Yusuf thought paper returns were earlier. The printer fails and they photograph a document instead. Later a section needs a document that takes weeks. This time it resolves without Sigma: the deadline is on the form, or an old reminder email is in the inbox, or they decide to file early. Sigma is never addressed.

variations.context: A couple completing a tax return. The deadline uncertainty resolves without Sigma.

setting.mood: Dutiful evening admin, mildly grim, made bearable by company.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Becky handles numbers, Yusuf handles forms; they divide labour comfortably. Engaged four years.
setting.background: Evening. A tax return with freelance income neither fully understands.
setting.conversation_style: Two people at a table with a laptop and papers, digressing to avoid the task.

resolution_methods: The deadline is printed at the top of the form itself.
A reminder email from last year is still in Becky's inbox.
They decide to file early regardless and stop worrying about the date.
Yusuf remembers it correctly from the year he filed late.
They book an accountant and hand the whole thing over.
negative_variant_design.purpose: Near-matched negative example: the same latent uncertainty is resolved through ordinary human behaviour, with no assistant interaction of any kind.

realism_devices: One of them reads a guidance sentence aloud and it means nothing.
A digression lasts long enough that they lose their place in the form.
Becky finds an arithmetic error and is quietly pleased.
They agree to finish tonight and both know they will not.
A receipt turns up for something neither remembers buying.

user1.name: Becky
user1.role: Senior data analyst. Organised and analytically minded, direct about what she does not know, lightly self-deprecating.

user2.name: Yusuf
user2.role: Logistics and supply chain manager. Very well-travelled with accumulated practical knowledge; calm and quietly authoritative about logistics.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.

conversation_structure: The admin task should be interrupted by deliberate digression.
At least 50% of turns should be personal conversation.
The initial deadline disagreement must not lead to Sigma.
At least one problem must be solved without assistance.
The Sigma exchange must occupy exactly two turns.
The return must not be finished by the end.
The uncertainty must resolve without Sigma being addressed.
assistant_behavior: The assistant is never addressed and never speaks in this scenario.
quality_checks: At least 50% of turns should be ordinary conversation.
The deadline question should appear at least five turns before the Sigma request.
At least one problem should be resolved without Sigma.
The Sigma exchange should occupy no more than two turns.
The ending should leave the task incomplete.
No assistant interaction of any kind should occur.
